3 Children, 5 Generation & 4 Grand Children, 6 Generation all District 1.
I have owned a Small Print Shop 25 years & a Cookie Shop 10 years. Both are in District 1.
I am an advocate for the support of every Small Business in Imperial Beach.

I have been serving Imperial Beach for over 30 years. I served as a youth sports Coach 25 years. I served as a Chamber of Commerce Board Member 3 years. Current Athletic Club founding Board Member for 9 years.

I believe I am the right choice to serve on the Imperial Beach City Council the next 4 years. I am 30 experienced in running board meetings. I have experience in setting a budget. I have an overwhelming amount of support & you have my unconditional commitment to serve everyone in our small beach town community.
I am looking forward to serving you on the Imperial Beach City Council. Thank you for your vote.

text: I am a lifelong resident of the South Bay. I attended Berry Elementary, Southwest Middle and Southwest High School. I have lived in IB since 2020.
I am the San Diego Director of ACCE, a non-profit community organization, and I am finishing my first term as a School Board Trustee for the South Bay Union School District.

I am running for IB City Council to serve my community. I believe strongly in co-governance, and will work with the residents of district one and Imperial Beach as a whole to create an IB where our families have safe, affordable and dignified housing, safe streets, parks, clean air and a clean beach.
I am a loving husband and father of 3 boys, a teen, a preschooler and a baby.

As a community organizer I have worked with hundreds of renters in IB to pass tenant protections against unfair evictions, at Siesta Mobilehome park in 2019 and in 2024-2025 at the Swell Apts and Hawaiian Gardens.
I believe I will be a good council member since I understand what it’s like to organize with the community outside of city hall and also understand what it’s like to serve as an elected official.
